The shell copies the **real product shell** for behaviour and labels: `libs/reviewpro-ui/src/canvas` (`MainBarNext` top bar, `SidebarNav` rail and panel) in `frontend-workspace` master of 17 Nov 2026, checked against QA screenshots. Sizes, colours and states come from the Figma UI App file, Navigation page (`ubE7R2jeqiwS8BZ4a5vwHw`, node 7144:36598). The starters have the exact markup: keep it and change only the active section, the rail icons, the panel items, the breadcrumbs and the title.

```
Top bar        64px  sticky top:0          z 1000   RPP70 #014CB7, padding 12 16 (QA is green: never copy it; settings/profile pages DRPP100 #172554)
                                                    left, 16px apart: logo 32px white square (radius 4)
                                                      establishment selector 40px, padding 4 8: name 16/24 bold + "Establishment view" 12/18, Down-big chevron 24px
                                                      date selector: calendar 32px, dates 14px bold + "vs. ..." regular, Down-big chevron 24px
                                                      selector states: hover rgba(25,28,29,.2), open .4, pressed .8
                                                    right: 40px icon buttons 8px apart (the 32px icons sit 16px apart, as in Figma):
                                                      messages bell (red count) - help - app launcher (rp-icon-shiji-menu) - avatar 32px white square, initials 14 bold RPP70
Side bar       48px  sticky under top bar   z 1000   white rail; 32px items, 48px apart; default white, hover #E4E4E4, current #BFD3E3, pressed rgba(63,123,171,.1)
                                                    Knowledge Hub at the bottom: RPP70 square with the white Learning icon (lightbulb)
                                                    right-edge handle (3px #2E75B6 bar on hover) = Expand navigation: 267px rail with labels,
                                                      48px rows (padding 8 12, gap 16), current row #BFD3E3 with a 600 label, "New" chips
Section panel 220px  sticky under top bar   z 1000   closed on load; a rail icon opens it (and folds an expanded rail)
                                                    header 16/24 bold, padding 12 16; pages 14/22 in 40px rows, padding 8 16; current page #BFD3E3
                                                    hover a page = pin (set as default); ReviewPro Reputation logo (40px high) at the bottom
                                                    a page, a click outside or Escape closes it
Content              flex 1, padding 16, background #F8F8F8: PageHeader (title + actions, divider) or breadcrumbs + h4 title, filters, kit-stack of tiles
```
- **Top bar controls** carry `data-rp-top-bar`: `establishment`, `date`, `notifications`, `help`, `apps`, `account`. shared.js builds each overlay the first time (sample data, never saved by Tweak mode):
  - establishment: popover 391px wide, up to 480px high (Figma MenuSelector); full-width Establishment / Restaurant tabs (48px), focused small search, Most frequent · N Groups · N Establishments in 48px rows, count in grey, pin = default; choosing one updates the bar (Group view for a group)
  - date: Select a Date Period, 424px (Current Period with Day/Week/Month/Quarter/Year groups, From - To, Compare With:, From - To, Set as default, Apply); 48px fields with a 32px calendar icon; Apply writes both lines of the bar. Figma also draws a chevron in the date fields and no "-" between them: the product has the "-" and no chevron, and the kit follows the product.
  - notifications: All Messages drawer under the bar, grouped by date, sort menu (Newest, Priority, Oldest); opening a message lowers the count
  - help: menu · apps: Explore all Shiji Products · account: name and email, Personal Information, Language (opens the language list in place), Change Password, About Reviewpro Reputation (dialog), Logout
  - To show other content, ship an element with the same id in the page: `rp-top-bar-establishment`, `rp-top-bar-date`, `rp-top-bar-messages`, `rp-top-bar-help`, `rp-top-bar-apps`, `rp-top-bar-account`.
- **Two top bars.** Establishment view (a property or a group is selected) = `rp-top-bar` (RPP70 `#014CB7`). Account view = `rp-top-bar rp-top-bar-corporate` (DRPP100 `#172554`): the product shows it when no property is shown (settings, profile, account-level pages), with the user or account name in `rp-top-bar-establishment-text` and no establishment or date selector. Figma calls it TopNav Device=Corporate (its example still draws an "Account Name / Multi-Property view" selector). `rp-top-bar-settings` is the old name of the same bar.
- The current rail item has `rp-side-bar-item-active`, `data-rp-current` and `aria-controls` = its panel id. The current page in the panel has `rp-side-bar-panel-item-active`.
- Other rail items open their section list (shared.js builds it from the Figma SideNav/Desktop lists; a trailing `*` in `NAV` adds a New chip, `—` a divider). The Settings panel is All Settings, a divider, then the settings sections, each linking to `02-settings-hub.html#<section>`.
- **Page header** (`rp-page-header` = PageHeader; Figma headerPageContainer, Desktop Default): the page h1 (`rp-page-header-title`, h6 bold) and the page actions (`rp-page-header-actions`: ghost buttons, one primary) in one row, then the divider (`<hr class="rp-divider rp-page-header-divider" />`, 8px under the row) and 24px to the filters. The product leaves the divider out only when nothing follows the header (`hideDivider`): then drop the `hr` and put `data-rp-hide-divider` on `rp-page-header` (the checker warns about a header without either). Breadcrumbs go in `rp-page-header-text` above the title. Tabs mode (Figma Type=Tabs): `rp-page-header rp-page-header-tabs` with the `rp-tabs` inside, no title, no divider. Markup:

  ```html
  <div class="rp-page-header">
    <h1 class="rp-page-header-title">Reviews Dashboard</h1>
    <div class="rp-page-header-actions">
      <button type="button" class="rp-ghost-button rp-ghost-button-inherit">…Schedule report</button>
      <button type="button" class="rp-ghost-button">…Download report</button>
    </div>
  </div>
  <hr class="rp-divider rp-page-header-divider" />
  <div class="kit-toolbar">…filters…</div>
  ```
  Dashboards and new pages use it (52 product pages import PageHeader); `rp-page-title` (h4) stays for older pages that still show one. Example: `mockups/reviews-dashboard/`, starter 03.
- Rail icons are the sections the account has. The starters show the 12 Figma sections plus Knowledge Hub (Social Media and LiveFAQ stay in `NAV` for accounts that have them); a copied screenshot keeps exactly its icons, in its order.
- A dot on a rail icon (displayLabelNew, e.g. Dynamic Dashboard): wrap the icon in `rp-badge rp-badge-dot` with an empty `rp-badge-content`. Expanded, it becomes a "New" chip.
- The Knowledge Hub button only shows for beta accounts: keep it when the screenshot has it, remove the `rp-side-bar-knowledge-hub` button when it does not.
- QA screenshots have a green top bar. Mockups always use the blue one; `rp-top-bar-qa` exists only to show the QA environment on purpose (the checker warns about it).
- Content width: full by default; `rp-content-wrapper-constrained` limits it to 80% (max 1660px) like the new navigation proposal for non-dashboard pages.
- Breakpoints: theme sm 768, md 980, lg 1440. Mockups are built at 1440px.
## Rules
- Never a page without the shell (except embeddable widgets and guest-facing pages, which are out of scope for this kit).
- Establishment selection lives only in the top bar selector: no "hotel / group view" toggles.
- Every dashboard and list page has a title: `rp-page-header-title` in a PageHeader (dashboards and new pages) or `rp-page-title` (older pages). The settings hub has none (its search bar comes first).
